hostingRequirementsForChapter13: a stable HTTPS origin and rpId: the passkey and vault are bound to it, and changing it breaks recovery
verified ciphertext request-body limits at the edge (vault objects up to the envelope maximum) and a bounded assistant stream duration (the run ceiling is 120 s)

security headers on the deployed edge: the nonce CSP, frame-ancestors/X-Frame-Options, HSTS, no-store on authenticated responses, referrer and permissions policies; the standalone verifier needs frame-ancestors from host headers (F-014)
private object storage for ciphertext and a private PostgreSQL; no public bucket listing
secret separation: server-only Qwen, Alchemy and database credentials; only NEXT_PUBLIC_ values in the browser; the sponsor token only in the indexer process
no test seam in the deployed process (LEXAEGIS_TEST_* unset), checked against the running deployment
a re-run of pnpm validate:mvp --check and pnpm verify:deployment against the deployed configuration
notClaimed: No independent audit, legal compliance certification or zero-knowledge AI is claimed. Chapter 13 hosting checks have not run, so there is no production-ready badge.
